description:
List users in TalentLMS.

TalentLMS returns 20 users per page by default; pass page_size (max 1000) and page_number to page through larger tenants.

Returns: id, login, first_name, last_name, email, role, status, last_updated.

RELATED TOOLS:
- get_talentlms_user: Get full profile by ID
- get_talentlms_user_courses: See courses a user is enrolled in
name: list_talentlms_users
